title: The wind's direction (D176): a hexflower laid out as a compass, drifting a cell at a time like the weather's maps

start.description: The cell a new game starts in (and an old save, the first time it loads).

changeOn.description: Each half-hour step, roll12: at or under this, the wind moves (then 2d6 picks which way); over it, it stays.

steps.description: Which way the wind would move on the flower for each total of 2d6, from 2 to 12: a direction on the flower (src/engine/hexmap.js) or "stay". Keep it even-handed (each direction as likely as its opposite): the seasons' shares, not this table, make the prevailing wind.

variable.description: How often, in %, the wind has no set direction (the centre cell), in every season.

seasons.description: Per season, how often (%) the wind blows from each of the 12 directions, from N (0°) round by 30° to 330°. A move the 2d6 picks is kept outright towards a direction blowing at least as often, else on a d100 at or under 100 × the new share / the old one, so in the long run the wind blows as these say. From the University of Gdańsk's seasonal wind roses for 55.00N 18.33E, 1951-2010 (docs/decisions.md, D176).

cells.description: The 19 cells, in the hex map's order (src/engine/hexmap.js): 0 the centre, 1-6 the inner ring, 7-18 the outer.

from.description: The compass bearing the wind blows from, in degrees; null for a wind with no set direction (the centre). The outer ring is a steady wind, the inner ring the same direction unsettled.

changeSet.description: The cell each direction (n, ne, se, s, sw, nw) leads to: the hex map's neighbour, or this cell itself where the move would wrap round the flower's edge, so the wind never swings round in one step.
